name: River Warbler
rangeDescription: Central and eastern europe to western siberia; winters in eastern africa
description: Large, rather nondescript warbler. Dark with a plain brown back, faintly streaked breast, and pale belly.

name: Chestnut-eared Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Central vietnam (mount kon ka kinh)
description: Beautiful brownish laughingthrush with intricate black dappling, speckling, and spotting all over the body. Note orange ear patch, pale bluish eyebrows and wing panel, and messy black smattering on the lower neck.

name: Sangihe Whistler
rangeDescription: Sangihe islands (north of sulawesi)
description: A chunky, dingy-looking, thick-billed songbird. Upperparts dark olive-brown, with a grayish head and a pale buff wash on the underparts.

name: Tanimbar Boobook
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (arafura sea)
description: A distinctive chestnut-colored owl from the Tanimbar Islands. Bright reddish-brown with scattered white markings on wings, barred underparts, and piercing yellow eyes.

name: Sooty Gull
rangeDescription: Red sea and persian gulf area to southern pakistan and northern kenya
description: Medium-sized elongated gull. Brown-gray overall with a long bill and dark underwings.

name: Fiery-browed Myna
rangeDescription: Mountains of sulawesi
description: An unmistakable, long-tailed, conspicuous myna with a broad orange eyebrow, a pale eye, an ash-gray body, mossy green wings and tail, and a contrasting yellowish rump. Juvenile browner, with a narrower eyebrow and a dark eye.

name: Restless Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Northern queensland to victoria and southern south australia; southwestern western australia
description: A sturdy songbird with fairly long tail and substantial bill. Glossy black above, bright white below.

name: Masked Cardinal
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia (southward to northern meta and eastern vichada), venezuela (except far southern) and trinidad
description: Unmistakable tricolored bird, with bold red, black, and white patches. Red hood and throat, black mask, mostly black back and tail, and white underparts.

name: Inca Flycatcher
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru (amazonas to cusco)
description: Fairly small flycatcher that perches upright in the mid-story of montane forest and cloud forest. Subtly colorful, with a diffuse gray facial pattern.

name: Bacan Myzomela
rangeDescription: Bacan (northern moluccas)
description: A small honeyeater with a short, downcurved bill. Striking male shows a scarlet head, back, and rump, a contrastingly dark tail and wings, and a whitish belly.

name: Madagascar Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Madagascar; winters in eastern africa
description: A typical Old World cuckoo, with gray-and-white plumage and long wings and tail. A brood parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of many other bird species.

name: Magellanic Penguin
rangeDescription: Patagonian coasts, staten, falkland, and juan fernández islands
description: Fairly common to locally common; often seen in inshore waters and from ferries. Breeds around coasts of southern Chile, Argentina, and in the Falklands; nests in colonies in underground burrows.

name: Siberian Grouse
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of northeastern asia
description: Chunky medium-sized gamebird of far eastern Russia. Both sexes are dark brown with white-spotted underparts.

name: Brownish-headed Antbird
rangeDescription: Southern peru (cusco, madre de dios, and puno) and far west-central bolivia
description: Dull-plumaged antbird with a restricted range in the Andean foothills. Males are grayish brown with small white wing spots; females are similar, but are paler tan below.

name: Sooty Shearwater
rangeDescription: Breeds southern south america, new zealand, and southeastern australia; winters to north pacific and north atlantic
description: Medium-sized, dark brown shearwater with silvery flashes on underwings. Narrow wings with quick, deep wingbeats.

name: Sooty Thrush
rangeDescription: Mountains of costa rica and western panama (far western chiriquí)
description: Very dark montane thrush. Robin-sized, all black with white eye and yellow eyering, bill, and legs.

name: Black-browed Barbet
rangeDescription: Montane forest of malay peninsula and sumatra
description: Loud but sluggish and difficult-to-see canopy inhabitant of highland forests in peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra. Note the leaf-green body, brightly colored face, and heavy black bill.

name: Gray Kestrel
rangeDescription: Savanna and woodland of sub-saharan africa
description: Medium-sized gray falcon with bright yellow eye-ring and base of the bill. Quite plain, but does show barring on the wings in flight.

name: Red-faced Cormorant
rangeDescription: Central coastal subarctic north pacific from kamchatka, northern and central kuril and commander islands (southeastern russia) to southern kuril islands and eastern hokkaido (northern japan); aleutian and pribilof islands (bering sea) and southern alaskan islands
description: Dark glossy-green cormorant with a bluish neck, red face, and yellowish bill. White patches on sides of rump.

name: Yemen Serin
rangeDescription: High altitude bushy hills of southwestern saudi arabia
description: Small, slim seedeater of the southern Arabian highlands. Brown overall, with a buffy face and whitish underparts.
